content:
Our research team at the University of Pennsylvania is looking for participants for a study to evaluate the usability of a new interactive tool for writing and debugging Lean proofs! The study will consist of a ~1 hour recorded Zoom call, during which you will write a few Lean proofs and answer some questions about the experience. Compensation is $30.

If you are interested in participating , please fill out this form!

Feel free to send any questions to Cassia Torczon, ctorczon@upenn.edu.
